1.script: LIFE IN ARMENIA Inside the Daily Life, Culture and Traditions of a Country Shaped by Mountains and History Imagine waking up in a country where ancient monasteries stand beside modern apartment buildings, where a five-thousand-year-old history meets smartphones and technology, and where family traditions can be just as important as a person's career. A country surrounded by mountains, shaped by difficult history, and connected to millions of people living far beyond its borders. This is Armenia.

47.script: THE FOOD OF ARMENIA If you want to understand Armenia, sit at an Armenian table. Food is one of the strongest expressions of culture. Armenian cuisine is built around fresh ingredients, meat, vegetables, herbs, grains and dairy products. One of the most recognizable foods is lavash. This thin flatbread has been part of Armenian food culture for generations. It can be used to wrap food, accompany a meal or simply be shared at the table.

They can work for an international company while celebrating traditional holidays. They can live in a modern apartment while cooking recipes that have been passed down for generations.
